preparation.title: Building your review
preparation.note: You can leave this screen and return later. Your generated questions are saved as they become ready.

stages.SELECTING_VOCABULARY: Choosing the words that will help you most today…
stages.CHECKING_CACHE: Checking which questions are already ready…
stages.GENERATING_QUESTIONS: Creating fresh questions from your saved contexts…
stages.CREATING_SESSION: Putting the questions into your review…
stages.PLANNING_SESSION: Balancing the order and learning focus…
stages.FAILED: Preparation stopped before the review was ready.

fillBlank.hintError: The next hint could not be loaded. Try again.
fillBlank.hintStale: This question changed. Refresh the review before requesting another hint.

starter.modeTitle: How would you like to review?
starter.modeDescription: Choose a mode to create questions that suit today's goal.

modeDescriptions.BALANCED: Mix recognition, recall, spelling, and context.
modeDescriptions.RECALL: Practice recalling the right word from its meaning.
modeDescriptions.SPELLING: Practice typing words accurately from sentence clues.
modeDescriptions.CONTEXT: Practice choosing meanings that fit real contexts.

starter.invalidLink: This review link is not valid. Return home and choose a review again.
starter.emptyDescription: There are no saved words ready for this review. Keep reading or choose another collection.
starter.errorDescription: Your saved words are safe. Check your connection and try again.

fillBlank.context: Read the whole sentence and notice what kind of word the blank needs.
fillBlank.grammar: Check the words beside the blank for clues about tense, form, or number.

selectMeaning.context: Recall how the word was used in its original sentence.
selectMeaning.specific: Choose the most specific meaning that fits that context.

selectWord.rephrase: Say the meaning in your own words before looking at the choices again.
selectWord.form: Look for the word whose form and tone best match the meaning.

selectContext.meaning: Look for the sentence where the word carries the meaning you learned.
selectContext.eliminate: Read each choice with the target word and remove contexts that feel unrelated.

errors.staleLoadFailed: The latest review state could not be loaded. Try refreshing again.
errors.staleLoading: This question changed. Loading the latest review state…
errors.answerSave: Your answer could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
errors.skip: This word could not be skipped. Check your connection and try again.
errors.endConflict: This session changed before it could be ended. Close this dialog and refresh the review.
errors.end: The session could not be ended. Check your connection and try again.
errors.sessionUnavailable: This review session is not available.
errors.restore: Your review could not be restored. Try again.

endDialog.title: End this review session?
endDialog.description: This closes the current session, so it will no longer be available to resume. Choose Save and exit instead if you want to continue later.
